name: B10-0293/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It condemns Nicaragua's government for repression and crimes against humanity. It asks for the release of Carlos Brenes and Salvadora Martínez Aburto, held since August 2025, and for an independent investigation into the death in custody of Indigenous leader Brooklyn Rivera. It also calls on the European Union and its member states to widen sanctions and give more support to civil society and democratic groups in Nicaragua.

- The European Parliament asks Nicaragua to free detainees and investigate Rivera's death; nothing changes in law.
- It affects Carlos Brenes, Salvadora Martínez Aburto, Brooklyn Rivera's family and other Nicaraguan detainees.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, Commission and Nicaraguan authorities; EU sanctions may be widened.
